verdict.rationale: Dots does not issue API credentials, but it does let users limit what the agent can do. Existing ChatGPT app permissions carry over to the dot, so a user can allow reading email without allowing sending (dots-docs-21). Action rules can also govern how the dot handles specific actions (dots-docs-20). Missing for 10: issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for the agent, any public API surface (no dots-specific API, CLI, or MCP surface was found), credential lifecycle controls such as expiry, rotation and revocation, and independent corroboration.
